items: (a) Remove the ground strap and the rubber exhaust hanger.

content.description: Rear view showing rear support member with eight bolts marked for removal, ground strap and rubber exhaust hanger visible

items: (b) Remove the eight bolts and support.

content.text: Remove the six bolts. If necessary, tap the extension housing with a soft-faced hammer or block of wood to loosen it.

content.description: Side view of transmission showing extension housing with six bolts to be removed

items: (a) Wash components in clean solvent, and dry with compressed air.
(b) Check the case, speedometer gear and output shaft for cracks, wear or damage.

content.description: Hand holding and inspecting transmission components including speedometer gear and output shaft

content.text: NOTE: If necessary, install a new oil seal before installation. (See page AT-103)
1. INSTALL NEW GASKET AND EXTENSION HOUSING ON TRANSMISSION
Install the six bolts finger tight, then torque them.
NOTE: The two lower bolts are shorter.

content.description: Side view of transmission showing extension housing with gasket being installed with six bolts, noting two lower bolts are shorter
